title: My account
subtitle: View your information and set the application’s language and theme.

info.title: Account information
info.name: Full name
info.hint: This information is provided by {{origin}} and cannot be edited here. Contact {{origin}} if changes are needed.

language.title: Language
language.only: No other language is available than {{language}}.

refresh.title: Data refresh
refresh.hint: How often the displayed information (alerts, check-ins/check-outs, attendance…) is automatically reloaded without leaving the page. Only the data visible on screen is refreshed. Even when off, the day’s data (arrivals, departures, birthdays) is renewed at midnight.

personalData.title: My personal data
personalData.learnMore: Learn more about how your data is used

extract.title: Get an extract of my data
extract.description: You will receive by email an archive containing all the data linked to your account: profile, project access, attendance, check-ins/check-outs and communications.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.description: Permanently deletes your Registry account: your profile, your preferences and your access to your projects will be erased. A confirmation will be requested.
delete.adminNote: Not possible if you are the last administrator of the application or of a project: first appoint another administrator, or delete the project.

confirmation.title: Delete my account
confirmation.intro: You are about to permanently delete your Registry account.

items.access: your access to all your projects (the projects themselves are not deleted)

confirmation.scope: Only your Registry account is affected, not your account with {{organization}}.
confirmation.reconnect: If you sign in again later, a blank account will be created: you will start from scratch, with no access to your former projects.
